statements.summary: Today and tonight. Showers and thunderstorms are expected this evening and into the overnight. Some storms could be severe with damaging winds, large hail, and heavy downpours possible.

details.label: Today's Hazards
details.text: Today and tonight. Showers and thunderstorms are expected this evening and into the overnight. Some storms could be severe with damaging winds, large hail, and heavy downpours possible.

details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Wednesday through Monday. Showers and thunderstorms are expected on Wednesday and Thursday, Some storms could be severe on both days. Mainly during the afternoon and evening but there is a potential for some overnight storms as well.
